question: Which persons fallen from caste status are included in this ritual provision?
premises: A group fallen from caste is identified.
The group includes twice-born persons and others.
The relative pronoun marks them as the subjects of the rule.
inference: Those who have fallen from caste, including twice-born persons and others, are the intended subjects.
plain_english: Those who have fallen from their caste, such as the twice-born and others.
